finite_cluster_gate: For a three-endpoint Holm family at alpha 0.05, best-case significance requires >=7 repositories; current 4- and 6-repository designs are structurally ineligible.

methods.acceptance_yield: paired risk difference; repositories sampled first and intact pairs sampled within selected repositories
methods.binding: S05 LOW binding AND not S05 HIGH AND named non-S05 HIGH binding
methods.domain_dependent: qualified heterogeneous repository/task effects cannot be overridden by pooling
methods.interactions: condition effects by repository and task class; difficulty retained
methods.migration: binding conjunction plus manipulation, controls, adequate power and primary threshold
methods.mixed_effects: repository is outer resampling unit; paired templates remain intact within repositories; repository-by-task strata retain difficulty
methods.multiplicity: Holm adjustment of exact repository-cluster sign-flip p-values for acceptance yield, absolute throughput, and relative RMST; ordinary bootstrap draws are never null p-values
methods.throughput: absolute accepted-all-gates-per-480-active-minute cluster statistic; >=15% cohort-relative threshold; repository-then-pair hierarchical interval bootstrap
methods.time_to_valid: tie-grouped Kaplan-Meier RMST relative change through 480 minutes; events applied before same-time censor removal
methods.uncertainty: two-sided percentile 95% intervals from 10,000 deterministic hierarchical repository/pair resamples

no_silent_fallback: Any unavailable or malformed required method raises an error; no simpler substitute is permitted.
null_inference: Exactly enumerate all 2^R repository-cluster sign patterns; two-sided p-values count the observed and symmetric opposite patterns. Monte Carlo draws do not increase finite resolution.
primary_endpoint_evidentiary_conjunction: All three exact p-values reject after Holm AND yield difference >=0.10 AND throughput relative change >=0.15 AND RMST relative change <=-0.15.
unit: paired template cluster nested in repository and crossed with task class/difficulty
